workload.description: Parse a long semicolon-separated parameter string, including a quoted malformed variant.

validation.details: Ran natively with Python 3.12 against a public export of the pinned patched snapshot at sizes 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16; correctness assertions passed and marker_probe observed the target region.

tests.coverage_note: Loads the pinned source file, asserts its resolved path, exercises _parseparam with bounded input, and verifies entry into the empty region marker.
